name: Top-level storage access (requestStorageAccessFor)
plain: Lets a top-level page request cookie access on behalf of related embedded sites.
meaning: Allows a page to unlock third-party cookies for sites in the same Related Website Set. Chrome only and deprecated; its use hints at cross-site identity joining.

access.prompt_ui: Chrome only: prompt unless the sites are in the same Related Website Set.

limits.headline: Can ask Chrome to let related embedded sites use their cookies, if you allow
limits.user_action: You tap a button on the page, then answer the Chrome prompt if one appears.
can: Ask for cookie access for related sites embedded in the page
Skip the prompt when the sites are in the same Related Website Set
Use that access after you allow it
cannot: Do it in Firefox or Safari
Get access if you choose Block
limits.reach_label: Related sites only, after you allow
limits.differs: Chrome and Edge only. Firefox and Safari do not have it.

story.what_it_is: Lets a main page ask the browser to share cookies with its related embedded sites.

marketing.name: requestStorageAccessFor
marketing.pitch: Documents a call that lets a top level site request cookie access on behalf of related embedded sites.

story.for_you: You might see a prompt asking if related sites can share your sign in. Say yes and it works smoothly across a company's brands. Say no and you may need to log in again.
story.for_makers: It helps companies with several linked sites keep one sign in. It is a narrow path that browsers allow for related sites only. It is not meant for general ad tracking.

use_cases.example: A company with several brand sites lets one login work across all of them.
A store group shares your cart and login between its regional shops.
A media company keeps a subscription active across its linked news sites.
A game publisher keeps one account across its game and community sites.
A payment provider recognises you across a merchant's linked checkout sites.
An ad firm hopes to use it for tracking, but browsers limit it to closely related sites.

history.change: requestStorageAccessFor ships with Related Website Sets
